name: Agent Wool
author: Parker Brown
description: The whole flock on one wall — every coding agent's face, state and vitals, fed by the herd state bus

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one wall: every agent on the machine as a card — a face whose colour says how it's doing, the last prompt it saw, its context vitals — and a click that takes you to its window. Herd is attention; Wool is presence.

schema.label: Hide when no agents are reported
Wall refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the open wall re-syncs herdr and re-reads vitals. Nothing is scanned while the wall is closed.
